note: every identity-kit body part, one baked geometry each (see src/tools/cache-bake/itk-bake-run.mjs). Each part is the kit's own models merged and recoloured as the client merges them, tagged with the body part it is (partOf), so src/identikits.js can merge any seven into a player body and src/models3d.js can drop the part an item replaces. No animation is baked here - the merged body plays the human rig already carried by src/models/player_male.json.
